### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>gittools/actions</summary>

### [`v5.0.0`](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/releases/tag/v5.0.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/gittools/actions/compare/v4.7.2...v5.0.0)

As part of this release we had [57 commits](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/compare/v4.7.2...v5.0.0) which resulted in [1 issue](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/milestone/39?closed=1) being closed.

Next major release of GitTools Actions and Azure Pipelines tasks, including native GitVersion 7 support and its CLI, configuration, output and platform migrations.

**Breaking change**

- [**#&#8203;2262**](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/issues/2262) Support GitVersion 7 in GitTools Actions v5 by [arturcic](https://redirect.github.com/arturcic) resolved in [**!2287**](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2287) by [arturcic](https://redirect.github.com/arturcic), [**!2281**](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2281) by [arturcic](https://redirect.github.com/arturcic), [**!2279**](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2279) by [arturcic](https://redirect.github.com/arturcic), [**!2265**](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2265) by [arturcic](https://redirect.github.com/arturcic), [**!2264**](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2264) by [arturcic](https://redirect.github.com/arturcic), [**!2263**](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2263) by [arturcic](https://redirect.github.com/arturcic)

**Improvements**

- Simplify the GitVersion test version configuration ([#&#8203;2290](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2290)).
- Cache npm downloads in Azure Pipelines ([#&#8203;2294](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2294)).

**Documentation**

- Update the output examples for Actions v5 and GitVersion 7 ([#&#8203;2292](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2292)).

**Dependencies**

- Update the ESLint dependency group ([#&#8203;2288](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2288)).
- Update actions/setup-node to 7.1.0 ([#&#8203;2289](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2289)).
- Update GitTools/cicd to v6 ([#&#8203;2293](https://redirect.github.com/GitTools/actions/pull/2293)).
